description: Latest or dated reference rates. Provider rates retain published digits on their own base. Returns rate records; if any provider fails, returns {rates,errors} preserving successes. Retry only failed providers.

base.description: Base currency or asset code. Default EUR.

date.description: Single day YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest rates.

provider.description: Institution keys, e.g. ['ECB','HMRC']; omit for blended rates.

quotes.description: Requested currency codes. Supply whenever known; omit only to request all.

name: get_rates
title: Get exchange rates
